source_evidence: Current report – Discloses material events or information that the company chooses or is required to make public prior to its next scheduled quarterly or annual report.
answer: Use EDGAR to look for a public company’s Form 8-K when you want to review material information disclosed before its next scheduled quarterly or annual report. EDGAR identifies filings by form type, so look for “8-K” in the search results. The filing may cover different topics; for example, certain executive compensation changes and some business-combination information can be disclosed in an 8-K. EDGAR search results also show the item numbers included in each 8-K, which can help you identify the sections to review.
